question: A short electric dipole with moment $p_1$ is fixed at the origin and aligned with the x-axis. A second identical dipole with moment $p_2$ (where $|p_1|=|p_2|=p$) is placed on the x-axis at $x=r$. Initially, $p_2$ is also aligned with the x-axis. What is the minimum work that must be done by an external agent to move the second dipole to a position on the y-axis at $y=r$, while keeping its orientation parallel to the x-axis?
